items.title: 搬家计划（示例）
items.summary: 这是一张示例卡片。真实卡片由管家或队员用 stateutil.py upsert-item 写入。点开看详情：草稿、把握度、时间线，以及底部的 批准 / 驳回 / 完成。
items.summary_en: This is a sample card. Real cards are written by the steward or a teammate with stateutil.py upsert-item. Open it to see the draft, the confidence, the timeline, and Approve / Reject / Done at the bottom.
items.draft:
## 计划

| 步骤 | 产出 | 负责 |
|---|---|---|
| 比较三家搬家公司 | 一张对比表 | 研究员 |
| 通知清单 | 要改地址的地方 | 管家 |
| 打包时间表 | 每周清单 | 你 |

批准后才开始执行；驳回时写原因，管家会把原因整理成规则提议。
items.draft_en:
## Plan

| Step | Output | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Compare three movers | One comparison table | Researcher |
| Change-of-address list | Everywhere to update | Steward |
| Packing timeline | A checklist per week | You |

Work starts only after you approve. If you reject, give a reason; the steward turns reasons into rule proposals.
